test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘CASUAL’ is written as ‘SACLAU’ and ‘DESIRE’ is written as ‘SEDERI’. How will ‘FALLEN’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06c763f2e72003075eaee6af4738c1926ab7ccdc20924dbd0d1d31468dc27e74.png] 

The logic followed here:

 ‘CASUAL’ is written as ‘SACLAU’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09aa02f82bb6ee25ef16ab85e056c0fac8f10655b26893c1f336d2b2f2841d79.png] 

‘DESIRE’ is written as ‘SEDERI’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c6d55723d2cc1c36765fbaa7f86c6aaec1c7a45f56d2b7096c1dfd50a0426eb.png] 

Similarly, ‘**FALLEN**’ will be written:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/150b01bd06c030650fd08f41bb0e0d74d156818984af0c414cfe3e7e07c1e417.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
